findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 列出主要對手：Pharma 為 McKesson、Cencora 等；GMPD 為 Medline、Owens & Minor 等；並稱新進入者、新商業模式與產業整併可能加劇競爭壓力、壓縮利潤，客戶整併可能導致從兩家既有供應商中只選一家而流失客戶。未揭露具體份額數字或具名新進入者。
findings.excerpt: Competitive pressures in each of our businesses may also be increased by new business models, new entrants, new regulations, or changes in enforcement priorities, changes in consumer demand, or general competitive dynamics. Our businesses face continued pricing pressure from these and other factors, which adversely affects our margins.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年 CAH 份額增減的權威數字或具名新進入者／替代供應商搶單的報導；僅有二手股評（Zacks 提及 McKesson／Cencora 於專科配銷競爭加劇），未取得可逐字原文故未列入。
